features.description: Data model + storage primitive: MaterialRef kind discriminator + image fields + validator; adk/activity_images.py slot helper over the ADK ArtifactService; curriculum builders filter to kind=='curriculum'
acceptance_criteria: MaterialRef round-trips both kinds via alias; validator rejects image-without-materialId and curriculum-without-docId
save_activity_image -> load_activity_image round-trips bytes + mime via InMemoryArtifactService (singleton reset per test); delete removes the slot; missing slot loads as None
build_curriculum_retrieval_tool and build_curriculum_grounding_preamble ignore kind=='image' refs
make test-fast green for the new unit + tool tests
features.notes: Use _reset_artifact_service_for_tests() per test. Keep doc_id optional (default '') for back-compat.

features.description: Teacher-only upload endpoint POST /api/activity-images (+ DELETE): type/size gate, save to activity slot, return image MaterialRef
acceptance_criteria: Student (group_id present) gets 403 on POST and DELETE
Happy path saves to the durable slot (verified via load_activity_image) and returns a well-formed image MaterialRef (kind=image, materialId, mimeType, studentVisible=false)
DELETE removes the slot (204); make test-fast green
features.notes: Router mount mirrors curriculum_routes. Endpoint does NOT write MaterialRef to ActivityConfig (the builder full-overwrite save owns that).

features.description: Image loader (before_agent) copies durable->session artifact at session start; image injector (before_model) inlines an image Part; wired into agent.py composed callbacks
acceptance_criteria: Loader copies a durable activity image into the student session + records id in app:activity_images_loaded; idempotent on a 2nd turn; orphaned id re-loads
Injector inserts a Part whose inline_data.mime_type starts with 'image/' ahead of the trailing user content, with a naming text Part
Injector is a no-op when no images loaded and skips a mid-turn function_response turn
Loader wired after _document_loader in _composed_before_agent; injector after _document_injector in _composed_before_model (before budget gate); make test-fast green
features.notes: Twins of make_document_loader/make_document_injector. Human gate: JB image-retention posture before pilot-env ship (not blocking code).

features.description: Frontend: MaterialsSection image-upload affordance (fetchWithTeacherAuth -> /api/activity-images), thumbnail chips, visibility toggle, remove->DELETE; MaterialRef type fields
acceptance_criteria: Image file upload calls fetchWithTeacherAuth against /api/activity-images (NOT the curriculum ingest helper)
Returned image MaterialRef renders as a thumbnail chip; studentVisible toggle + remove (DELETE then drop ref) behave
A non-image document still routes to curriculum ingest (no regression)
features.notes: Q4: auto-route by MIME behind the existing Upload button. accept includes image extensions.
